inlines.v: OFFI'CIOUSNESS, noun 1. Eagerness to serve; usually, an excess of zeal to serve others, or improper forwardness, interposing in affairs without being desired, or with a disposition to meddle with the concerns of others. 2. Service. [Little used.]
